why_fits.headline: You recruit for a living.
why_fits.body: Their entire business is placing FinTech tech & sales talent. Consultant call quality - BD, headhunting, qualification - directly drives billings. ORCA gives every desk weekly coaching and reps on exactly those skills, from agency founders and performance experts.

why_fits.headline: Training is already in your DNA.
why_fits.body: HS won Best In-House Training and says 'training is at the beginning of everything.' ORCA isn't a culture change - it's leverage. It frees the exec team from running every session and adds an always-on, world-class curriculum on top of onboarding.

why_fits.headline: Three brands, three cities, one bar.
why_fits.body: Harrington Starr, North Starr & Search 5.0 across London, Belfast & NYC. Live and on-demand coaching delivers the same standard to every consultant - graduate to senior - on every continent, with no trainers on planes.

open_with: Training is at the beginning of everything here - how are you scaling that as the team grows across London, Belfast and New York?
You've won Best In-House Training - where does the exec team's time go that you'd love to hand to an always-on platform?
